answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. By the dawn of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. A falcon of per-task receipts records who did what, and the vine of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, forfeited on duplicate submission, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name.
